planting.note: Set out nursery plants in spring once soil has warmed, giving each plant room to form a dense, rounded mound without crowding.

directions: Pink Pop was bred by Terra Nova Nurseries as a compact hummingbird mint, forming a tidy, rounded mound of aromatic gray-green foliage topped with dense spikes of clear pink flowers from early summer into fall. It served as one of the parent lines behind later Terra Nova introductions such as Summer Sky, passing on its compact habit and clean pink color. Give it full sun and sharply drained, lean soil, since it resents wet winter feet far more than summer drought. Bees and hummingbirds visit the spikes steadily through the long bloom season, and established plants need only an occasional spring tidy-up rather than regular feeding or staking.
